# Azelis is the reference innovation service provider in the speciality chemicals and food
# ingredients industry

[Touching the lives of people everywhere][74] [Our commitments to the wider community][75]

.

### Innovation

As a speciality distributor of chemicals and food ingredients, we’re now a fully integrated,
leading, innovative service provider. With innovation and collaboration at our heart, we believe
anything is possible.
* [Application laboratories][76]
* [Sampling and evaluation][77]
* [REACH compliance management][78]
* [International supply chain][79]

.

### Markets

Azelis services fifteen specific markets worldwide, bringing high-quality products, technical
expertise and local service support to each. Our international team is united in its hunger and
humility. Collaborating across 70+ laboratories to be a benchmark for innovation. A focus for
ambitious brands. And a catalyst that helps our customers to solve challenges and improve lives.
* [Life Sciences][80]
* [Industrial Chemicals][81]

.

### Customer Portal

The Azelis Customer Portal is a connected experience that inspires you with trends and inspirational
content for your selected markets, linking you to formulations, products, and related documentation.
From one digital experience you can order samples, request quotes and reorder products from Azelis.

Register at [Explore.Azelis.com][82]

26 June 2026: Croda opens new Guangzhou hub, bringing together fragrance and beauty actives
expertise to enhance customer collaboration and innovation across Asia.

## [ News ][112]

Discover the latest news from Croda, showcasing our smart science, sustainable innovation, business
updates and global collaborations.

## [ Consumer Care ][113]

Consumer Care combines our businesses closest to consumers, offering innovative, sustainable
solutions for home care, beauty, personal care, and fragrance. Our expertise enables us to provide
tailored formulations to meet global consumer demands.

[Consumer Care]

## Our markets

We provide innovative ingredients and develop solutions for customers that enhance the performance
of their products and help them to differentiate their brands.

[Read more Our markets ][114]

## [ Consumer Care ][115]

Consumer Care combines our businesses closest to consumers, offering innovative, sustainable
solutions for home care, beauty, personal care, and fragrance. Our expertise enables us to provide
tailored formulations to meet global consumer demands.

## [ Life Sciences ][116]

We provide high-quality healthcare solutions, protect crops, and enhance seeds, supporting global
health and crop sustainability. Our growing range of technologies ensures we deliver high value to
customers worldwide.

## [ Industrial Specialties ][117]

Industrial Specialties serves our retained businesses in coatings, textiles, fibers, water
treatment, and niche industrial markets, providing essential formulation ingredients and sustainable
solutions from key Croda manufacturing sites worldwide.

Discover how Croda’s high-quality ingredients, scientific expertise and sustainable innovation
deliver end-to-end solutions that power growth across Consumer Care and Life Sciences.

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

## Our Groups:

[[Water treatment chemistry, equipment, full-service partner]][37]
[[Food and health sciences specialty ingredients supplier]][38]
[[Industrial solutions, bulk delivery, custom toll blending]][39]

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

[Hawkins-Locations Map-2025]

**Locations**

Having fast access to the equipment, support and the service you need for your operation is
important. That’s why Hawkins has been expanding. Check back often to see if we’ve opened a location
near you!

[Find Locations Near You][44]

**About Us**
Buske Logistics is a privately owned and operated third-party logistics (3PL) warehousing business
founded in 1923. Since 2009, the company has undergone a significant transformation, with Fortune
1,000 standards being implemented under the ownership of S.C. Johnson & Son, Inc. from 2009 to 2015.

New and enhanced systems, processes, and people development have been priorities under the current
management team, which acquired the company in 2015. Most recently, we have accelerated our capital
investments through a partnership with Fourshore Partners in March of 2022.

We are a global company providing a wide array of best-in-class logistics services to Fortune 500
clients in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico. Since our inception, we have been committed to offering our
partners the kind of personal attention that results in quick answers, superior value, cutting-edge
technology, and the most reliable performance in our industry.

## **42 Locations**

[Image of Buske's 30 locations across the U.S. and Canada]

## **Our History**

Our 100+ year history in the warehousing and logistics industry, combined with our ever-evolving
innovation and technological capabilities, keeps us firmly planted as a preeminent 3PL organization.

Since day one, we’ve fulfilled the most demanding needs of Fortune 1,000 companies across various
industries, from food and beverage to automotive manufacturing.

# Cailà&Parés Empresa Oleoquímica

## Fabricación y Distribución de Productos Oleoquímicos

Cailà y Parés S.A. es una empresa oleoquímica con casi 100 años de historia realizando la
**fabricación ** y **distribución de ácidos y aceites grasos** a diferentes zonas del mundo. Puede
conocer más detalles sobre nuestra planta oleoquímica haciendo clic sobre los enlaces inferiores
para comenzar a navegar y conocer más sobre Cailà y Parés, como nuestros productos oleoquímicos, el
cumplimiento de la política medioambiental o conocer alguno de nuestros clientes internacionales.

### Fabricación de Ácidos Grasos fuera del ámbito de aplicación del EUDR (Non-EUDR)

Nuestros ácidos grasos Non-EUDR se fabrican en España utilizando materias primas de origen vegetal
fuera del alcance de la normativa EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation). Apostamos por un
abastecimiento responsable y sostenible, priorizando cadenas de suministro trazables y rutas
logísticas cortas dentro de Europa. Gracias al origen de nuestras materias primas y a la proximidad
de la cadena de suministro, contribuimos a reducir la huella de carbono asociada al producto y al
transporte.

### Venta de Ácidos Grasos y Especialidades Químicas para la Industria

Descubre nuestra empresa líder en la fabricación y distribución de productos oleoquímicos de alta
calidad. Ofrecemos una amplia gama de soluciones innovadoras y sostenibles para diversas
aplicaciones industriales. Nuestros [**productos oleoquímicos**][31], derivados de fuentes
naturales, **cumplen con los estándares más exigentes, garantizando eficacia, confiabilidad y
respeto por el medio ambiente.** Colaboramos estrechamente con nuestros clientes para satisfacer sus
necesidades específicas y proporcionar soluciones a medida. Explora nuestra gama de productos y
descubre cómo podemos impulsar el éxito de tu negocio con nuestros productos oleoquímicos de
vanguardia.

to providing quality in the worldwide marketplace.

We founded our trading company to serve a variety of fatty acids, soap noodles, and glycerin after
MSD Global saw the potential presented by the plentiful supply of palm oil and palm kernel oil in
Malaysia and Indonesia, as well as the preference for vegetable-based oleochemicals in numerous
industries.

Glycerine, soap noodles, and fatty acids derived from palm oil are now commonly available in
international markets. We are now able to supply the United States, Europe, Africa, the Middle East,

Refined Glycerin and more.

that create a variety of premium sustainable oleochemicals made from feedstock derived from
vegetables. Our product line includes fatty alcohols, fatty esters, basic fatty acids, and
glycerine. Numerous end-use applications make use of our products.

Green chemicals, sustainable development, and environmental friendliness are the new priorities of
modern society.

concentrating on new downstream business, supported by a strong confidence in innovation and
thorough market research.

* Through our large-volume business integration and logistical advantages of its business model, MSD

О методике Pro-Acne
Методика Pro-Acne — системный подход с доказанной эффективностью.
* Точная диагностика типа и степени акне.
* Подробный сбор информации и анамнеза.
* Протоколы домашних режимов с активами: кислоты, эксфолианты, бензоил пероксид.
* Корректировка режимов с учетом индивидуальных реакций кожи и прогресса в лечении.
* Назначение поддерживающего ухода, который помогает коже адаптироваться к активам и обеспечить
  бесперебойное лечение.
* Введение клиента в специальную элиминационную диету, исключающую пищевые акне-триггеры.
* Выявление персональных акне-триггеров в питании, что позволяет клиенту в перспективе не
  ограничивать все потенциальные провокаторы акне.
* Поиск и устранение бытовых триггеров (от выбора средств для стирки до правил посещения бассейна).
* Поминутные протоколы многоступенчатых процедур в кабинете: чистки, пилинги, светолечение, лазер.
* специально разработанные для этого метода косметические средства, которые производятся в США
  и сертифицированы;
* способы лечения акне с применением косметических машин и без них.

## Our Products

Alfa chemistry offers a variety of surfactants for customers.
* [Anionic Surfactants]
  
  ### Anionic Surfactants
  
  Anionic surfactants are surface actives that ionize negative charges in water. In the production
  of surfactants, anionic surfactants occupy the maximum variety and quantity.
  
  [Product Info >][62]
* [Cationic Surfactants]
  
  ### Cationic Surfactants
  
  Cationic surfactant is a positively charged surfactant and refers to a hydrophilic base whose
  molecules are dissolved in water and attached to a lipophilic base.
  
  [Product Info >][63]
* [Non-ionic Surfactants]
  
  ### Non-ionic Surfactants
  
  Non-ionic surfactants, consisting of a hydrophilic head group and a hydrophobic tail, carry no
  charge and are relatively non-toxic.
  
  [Product Info >][64]
* [Amphoteric Surfactants]
  
  ### Amphoteric Surfactants
  
  Amphoterics are surfactants with ionic charge and they can change between anionic properties, the
  isoelectric neutral stage and the cationic properties depending on the pH value.
  
  [Product Info >][65]
* [Special Surfactants]
  
  ### Special Surfactants
  
  Polymer Surfactants, Silicone Surfactants, Fluoro Surfactants, Natural surfactants.
  
  [Product Info >][66]

## Over 130 years of expertise. A new beginning.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster
decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.
